name: hyphen-half-also-word
what: A pair whose half the other text also holds as a word of its own: the witness's 'note-'/'book' is joined against the reading's 'notebook' (1); its half 'book' went into that word and does not answer a second time for the reading's own 'book'. Witness words the notebook = 2, found. Reading words the notebook book = 3; 'book' unconfirmed.
